MAR.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.

facts.fact: Lodj.ma reports that the CNSS launched a tender, estimated at 6 million dirhams, to select a provider for an AI chatbot that CNSS staff will use to query its document and database holdings, with a later phase planned to serve insured members.

MAR.note: The chatbot is a tender for an internal information tool and gives no diagnosis, score or decision.
The provider is yet to be selected and no AI model or dataset built in the country is stated.
